shortDescription: Create, update, or delete GitLab merge requests

options.name: api_job_token
options.description: GitLab CI job token for logging in.

options.name: api_oauth_token
options.description: GitLab OAuth token for logging in.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to use for authentication against the API.

options.name: api_token
options.description: GitLab access token with API permissions.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The resolvable endpoint for the API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to use for authentication against the API.

options.name: assignee_ids
options.description: Comma separated list of assignees usernames omitting V(@) character. Set to empty string to unassign all assignees.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The CA certificates bundle to use to verify GitLab server certificate.

options.name: description
options.description: A description for the merge request. Gets overridden by a content of file specified at O(description_path), if found.

options.name: description_path
options.description: A path of file containing merge request's description. Accepts MarkDown formatted files.

options.name: labels
options.description: Comma separated list of label names.

options.name: project
options.description: The path or name of the project.

options.name: remove_source_branch
options.description: Flag indicating if a merge request should remove the source branch when merging.

options.name: reviewer_ids
options.description: Comma separated list of reviewers usernames omitting V(@) character. Set to empty string to unassign all reviewers.

options.name: source_branch
options.description: Merge request's source branch. Ignored while updating existing merge request.

options.name: state
options.description: Create or delete merge request.

options.name: state_filter
options.description: Filter specifying state of merge requests while searching.

options.name: target_branch
options.description: Merge request's target branch.

options.name: title
options.description: A title for the merge request.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not to validate SSL certs when supplying a HTTPS endpoint.
